Blissey

Normal

Johto · Generation 2

Blissey is a Normal-type Happiness Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 1.5 m tall and weighs 46.8 kg. It evolves from Chansey. Its highest base stat is HP (255), with a base stat total of 540.
